findings.message: account `Advance` has no leading `version` field; future schema changes can't branch on layout version at deserialize time
findings.suggestion: Add `pub version: u8` (or u16) as the first field. Initialise it to 1 on creation and bump on every layout change so `try_deserialize` can route old vs new bytes.

findings.message: account `Advance` has no trailing `_reserved` padding; every future field append becomes Unsafe (needs realloc or migration)
findings.suggestion: Add `pub _reserved: [u8; 64]` (or similar) as the last field. Cheap at init time, converts future field appends to Additive.
